rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment, Art. XVIII §1806 (Eviction for cause only)
rules.requirement: Landlords of controlled units may not demand possession, serve a notice to quit, or sue to evict unless one of the listed just causes applies (e.g., nonpayment, material breach after written notice to cease, nuisance, owner/relative move-in, demolition, Ellis withdrawal). The notice must state the cause and be filed with the Rent Control Board within 3 days (except 3-day pay-or-quit notices). Retaliatory evictions are barred. Owner move-in requires good-faith occupancy within 60 days for at least two years, with protections for tenants 62+ or disabled with 5+ years or terminally ill.
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, § 1806
citation_aliases: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment
rules.quoted_span: No landlord shall take action to terminate any tenancy including but not limited, to making a demand for possession of a rental unit, threatening to terminate a tenancy, serving any notice to quit or other eviction notice
rules.effective_date_note: Article XVIII adopted 4/10/79; §1806 last amended with effect 12/6/22 (used original adoption date for the core rule). Exact effective date of 1979 adoption not stated beyond adoption date.
rules.key_value: Eviction only for enumerated just causes; cause stated in notice; copy filed with Rent Control Board within 3 days
rules.exemptions: Applies to controlled rental units; single family homes not rented July 1, 1984 are exempt (§1815); State Park/tidelands property exempt (§1820).
rules.penalty: Wrongful eviction: actual and punitive damages, injunctive relief, attorney fees; misdemeanor (fine up to $500 and/or up to 6 months jail) under §1810.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family homes not rented on July 1, 1984
State Park System / sovereign tidelands property
owner-occupied or other exemptions defined elsewhere in the Charter

rules.conflict_note: Applies to 'controlled rental units' as defined in other parts of the Charter (not in this part of the document); coverage may be uncertain.

rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment, Art. XVIII §1815 and §1820 (coverage exemptions)
rules.requirement: Single family homes not rented on July 1, 1984 are exempt from Santa Monica rent control; other single family homes are covered but can be permanently exempted after two years of continuous owner occupancy following a voluntary vacancy or lawful eviction. State Park and sovereign tidelands property is not covered.
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, §§ 1815, 1820
citation_aliases: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment
rules.quoted_span: Single Family homes that were not used for residential rental purposes on July 1, 1984 are automatically exempt from the provisions of this Article.
rules.effective_date_note: §1820 effective 12/10/90; §1815 adoption date not stated in this part.
rules.exemptions: Single family homes not rented July 1, 1984; owner-occupied single-family homes after 2 years; State Park/tidelands property.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family homes not rented on July 1, 1984
owner-occupied single-family homes exempted by Board
State Park System / sovereign tidelands property

rules.conflict_note: Rent cap formulas are in the earlier part of the Charter; this part provides only coverage exemptions.

parsed.doc_summary: Part 2 of the Santa Monica Charter Amendment (Art. XVIII): the end of §1805 (affordable-housing program), §1806 just-cause eviction grounds, notice, retaliation and remedies, §§1807-1821 (non-waiver, civil/criminal remedies, single-family and state-property exemptions, tenant harassment).
